reading.title: Grandpa's Shop
reading.text: My grandfather runs a small corner shop in our street. He opens the shop at seven o'clock every morning. He sells bread, milk and sweets. In the shop window there is always a big cake. On Saturdays I work in the shop with him. I am a shop assistant for the day! At six o'clock we close the shop and walk home together.

reading.title: Saturday at the Supermarket
reading.text: Every Saturday I go to the supermarket with my father. He takes a trolley and I push it. We buy food for the week. The supermarket is busy, and there is often a long queue at the checkout. A friendly woman serves each customer with a smile. My father is a regular customer, so she knows his name. The supermarket has good customer service.

reading.text: On Sundays my family has a big lunch. My mother buys fresh meat from the butcher on Saturday. She cooks roast chicken with potatoes and carrots. reading.text: Last summer we stayed in a small house by the sea. Every morning my father caught fresh fish and my mother fried it in a little olive oil. For breakfast I had a boiled egg and bread. reading.text: Last week our class visited a farm. We saw cows and a farmer showed us how to get fresh milk. We each drank a glass of milk and it was still warm! reading.text: My grandparents have a big garden behind their house. They grow vegetables like tomatoes, carrots and cucumbers. In summer we pick fruit from the trees: apples, plums and cherries.
